scope: All36 current non-landing side garment banks: material,tailored,cotton-day,tailored-day,complete-day,polished-day. All107male and102female native frames. Landing separately reviewed.
reviewMethod: All-frame semantic guide coverage scan plus independent actual WardrobeCompositor RGBA verification. Native same-frame visual review distinguishes skin/hand ink/footwear from old clothes. Source skin proof is partial: pink shoes and sole edges can be false positive skin candidates.
limitations: Counts are diagnostic candidates, not a claim that every exposed skin pixel is defective. Sleeveless cuts and short skirts intentionally expose arms/legs.
Retained1px guide boundaries preserve original hand/skin ink and antialiasing; residual source-cloth guide pixels are reported, not hidden.
Original video green matte fringe, variable body artwork, and existing sleeve/cloth donor distortions are outside this cloth-coverage correction.
Left renders mirror the whole native composite, not separately retargeted clothing.
